# fuse_ui_video: Theora (.ogv) decode for the video widget (UI10 media).
# Builds libtheora 1.2.0's decoder (BSD-3-Clause) from the release archive vendored at vendor/xiph-theora-v1.2.0.tar.gz
# (the same archive the Torque vcpkg port uses), checked against the raw sha256 below and extracted into the build tree.
# libogg comes from cmake/FuseXiph.cmake (fuse_xiph_ogg) when the full tree built it; a standalone UI build compiles its
# own copy from vendor/xiph-ogg-v1.3.6.tar.gz (pin: vendor/xiph/ogg/VERSION). No system library is used.
#   fuse_ui_theora      libtheora decoder (static, C, warnings off)
#   fuse_ui_theoraenc   libtheora encoder (static; only the gate links it, to make test clips)
#   fuse_ui_video       TheoraVideo: an in-memory .ogv as a widgets::VideoSource (random access by keyframe)
enable_language(C)
set(_fuse_ui_vendor "${FUSE_UI_REPO_ROOT}/vendor")
set(_fuse_ui_xiph "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_fuse_ui_xiph")
set(_fuse_ui_theora_sha "e0c35771b425c32a052ffb358a2aed14219340ab850b48dc85b01939c0513a31")
set(_fuse_ui_ogg_sha "95b643da661155d79db9de2fca55daed3a8d491039829def246aacb3d9201c81")

function(_fuse_ui_extract archive sha top out)
    set(${out} "" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(_tar "${_fuse_ui_vendor}/${archive}")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${_tar}")
        message(STATUS "fuse_ui_video: ${archive} missing")
        return()
    endif()
    set(_stamp "${_fuse_ui_xiph}/${top}.sha256")
    set(_have "")
    if(EXISTS "${_stamp}")
        file(READ "${_stamp}" _have)
        string(STRIP "${_have}" _have)
    endif()
    if(NOT _have STREQUAL sha OR NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${_fuse_ui_xiph}/${top}")
        file(SHA256 "${_tar}" _actual)
        if(NOT _actual STREQUAL sha)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "fuse_ui_video: ${archive} sha256 ${_actual} does not match the pin ${sha}")
        endif()
        file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${_fuse_ui_xiph}/${top}")
        file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${_tar}" DESTINATION "${_fuse_ui_xiph}")
        file(WRITE "${_stamp}" "${sha}\n")
    endif()
    set(${out} "${_fuse_ui_xiph}/${top}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(_fuse_ui_quiet t)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE /w)
    else()
        target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE -w)
    endif()
    set_target_properties(${t} PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
endfunction()

set(_ogg_target "")
if(TARGET fuse_xiph_ogg)
    set(_ogg_target fuse_xiph_ogg)
else()
    _fuse_ui_extract(xiph-ogg-v1.3.6.tar.gz ${_fuse_ui_ogg_sha} ogg-1.3.6 _ogg_dir)
    if(_ogg_dir)
        set(_gen "${_fuse_ui_xiph}/generated")
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_gen}/ogg")
        set(INCLUDE_INTTYPES_H 0)
        set(INCLUDE_STDINT_H 1)
        set(INCLUDE_SYS_TYPES_H 0)
        set(SIZE16 int16_t)
        set(USIZE16 uint16_t)
        set(SIZE32 int32_t)
        set(USIZE32 uint32_t)
        set(SIZE64 int64_t)
        set(USIZE64 uint64_t)
        configure_file("${_ogg_dir}/include/ogg/config_types.h.in" "${_gen}/ogg/config_types.h" @ONLY)
        add_library(fuse_ui_ogg STATIC "${_ogg_dir}/src/bitwise.c" "${_ogg_dir}/src/framing.c")
        target_include_directories(fuse_ui_ogg SYSTEM PUBLIC "${_ogg_dir}/include" "${_gen}")
        _fuse_ui_quiet(fuse_ui_ogg)
        set(_ogg_target fuse_ui_ogg)
    endif()
endif()

_fuse_ui_extract(xiph-theora-v1.2.0.tar.gz ${_fuse_ui_theora_sha} theora-1.2.0 _th_dir)
if(NOT _th_dir OR NOT _ogg_target)
    message(STATUS "fuse_ui_video: Theora or Ogg source unavailable; the video widget keeps its stub sources")
    return()
endif()

set(_tl "${_th_dir}/lib")
add_library(fuse_ui_theora STATIC
    "${_tl}/apiwrapper.c" "${_tl}/bitpack.c" "${_tl}/decapiwrapper.c" "${_tl}/decinfo.c" "${_tl}/decode.c"
    "${_tl}/dequant.c" "${_tl}/fragment.c" "${_tl}/huffdec.c" "${_tl}/idct.c" "${_tl}/info.c" "${_tl}/internal.c"
    "${_tl}/quant.c" "${_tl}/state.c")
target_include_directories(fuse_ui_theora SYSTEM PUBLIC "${_th_dir}/include")
target_include_directories(fuse_ui_theora PRIVATE "${_tl}")
target_link_libraries(fuse_ui_theora PUBLIC ${_ogg_target})
_fuse_ui_quiet(fuse_ui_theora)

add_library(fuse_ui_theoraenc STATIC
    "${_tl}/analyze.c" "${_tl}/encapiwrapper.c" "${_tl}/encfrag.c" "${_tl}/encinfo.c" "${_tl}/encode.c"
    "${_tl}/enquant.c" "${_tl}/fdct.c" "${_tl}/huffenc.c" "${_tl}/mathops.c" "${_tl}/mcenc.c" "${_tl}/rate.c"
    "${_tl}/tokenize.c")
target_include_directories(fuse_ui_theoraenc PRIVATE "${_tl}")
target_link_libraries(fuse_ui_theoraenc PUBLIC fuse_ui_theora)
_fuse_ui_quiet(fuse_ui_theoraenc)
set_target_properties(fuse_ui_theoraenc PROPERTIES EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ON)

add_library(fuse_ui_video STATIC src/theora_video.cpp)
target_include_directories(fuse_ui_video PUBLIC include)
target_link_libraries(fuse_ui_video PUBLIC fuse_ui_widgets PRIVATE fuse_ui_theora)
target_compile_definitions(fuse_ui_video PUBLIC FUSE_UI_HAVE_THEORA=1)
